title.zh: 四格漫画《程序员的一天》

tagline.zh: 编剧、画师、排版，都是同一个终端
tagline.en: Writer, illustrator and layout, all in one terminal

story.zh: 公司内刊缺一篇稿子，主编说来个四格漫画吧。你不会画画，但你有 Qoder。难点在于四张图里得是同一个人。
story.en: The company newsletter has a hole to fill and the editor wants a four-panel comic. You can't draw, but you have Qoder. The hard part: it has to be the same person in all four panels.

goal.zh: 先定剧本，再画四格，最后拼成一页带对白的漫画 index.html。
goal.en: Settle the script, draw the four panels, then lay them out with dialogue as a comic page in index.html.

openingPrompt.zh: 我要做一个四格漫画《程序员的一天》。先写剧本：四格分别是早上、中午、下午、深夜，每格一句画面描述和一句对白，最后一格要有反转。再定一个主角的固定外形描述，后面四张图都用它。先别画
openingPrompt.en: I'm making a four-panel comic, A Programmer's Day. Write the script first: morning, noon, afternoon, late night, with one line of scene description and one line of dialogue each, and a twist in the last panel. Then fix one description of the main character's look to reuse in all four images. Don't draw yet

hint.zh: 按回车发送。剧本不好笑就让它改，你是主编。
hint.en: Press Enter. If the script isn't funny, send it back. You're the editor.

hint.zh: 剧本定了，开画。四张图要等一会。
hint.en: Script approved. Draw it. Four images take a little while.

prompt.zh: 按剧本用内置的 ImageGen 工具画四格，图片名字依次用 panel-1 到 panel-4。四张图用同一段主角外形描述和同一种画风（简洁的黑白线条加一点强调色），图里不要出现文字
prompt.en: Draw the four panels from the script with the built-in ImageGen tool naming the images panel-1 through panel-4. Use the same character description and the same style in all four (clean black and white line art with one accent colour), and no text inside the images

hint.zh: 排版。对白用 HTML 写，比让模型在图里写字靠谱。
hint.en: Layout. Dialogue goes in HTML, which beats asking a model to letter inside an image.

prompt.zh: 做一页 index.html 把刚才那四张图（在 vibe_images 目录里）排成 2x2 的四格漫画：单文件，每格有编号和对白气泡，对白用剧本里的原话，顶部是标题，漫画纸风格
prompt.en: Build index.html laying out those four images (they are in vibe_images) as a 2x2 comic: single file, each panel numbered with a speech bubble using the script's exact lines, the title on top, comic paper styling
